_comment: The one resolution rule (docs/design/v6.43.0/multi-language.md §1, §5), as data. Read by backend/tests/unit/test_i18n.py (pick_locale, localized_field) AND frontend/src/i18n/__tests__/resolution-table.test.ts (resolveLocalized, localizedField), so the two sides cannot drift. fn 'pick' = a {locale: text} map or plain string resolved along locale → its language → default → its language → en → any value → "". fn 'field' = a base value plus per-locale variants: the locale, then its language, then the BASE (never the deployment default). 'default' is the deployment default locale; absent means en.

cases.name: plain string resolves to itself
map: exact locale
map: region falls back to its language
map: an exact region beats its language
map: unknown locale walks to the deployment default
map: a regional default falls back to its language
map: then the source locale
map: an empty string is skipped
map: a null value is skipped
map: nothing on the chain, so any value it has
map: empty map is the empty string
null is the empty string
field: the locale's variant
field: a field the locale doesn't list falls back to the base

cases.expect: Hi! How can I help you today?
